name: SBS_JOB_REQUESTS
description: Job Scheduler stores job-related information into a database

columns.name: JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The identifier column for every job request submitted via the job scheduler

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the job definition for this execution request

columns.name: SPECTRA_SERVICE_NAME
columns.description: The spectra service that owns this job

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the job definition

columns.name: JOB_SUBMITTER
columns.description: Job request submitting user

columns.name: JOB_RETRY_NUMBER
columns.description: Job request retry number, starting from 0, which is increased by 1 for every subsequent retry attempt

columns.name: LAST_ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Timestamp of last action

columns.name: LAST_ACTION
columns.description: Last action name, e.g. 'ENQUEUE_REQUEST', 'ENQUEUE_CANCEL_REQUEST'

columns.name: JOB_STATUS
columns.description: This column displays the status of the job request. Valid values are Submitted, Waiting, Running, Successful, Failed, Cancelled

columns.name: CANCEL_REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: The status for tracking the progress in processing the cancellation request.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_URGENCY
columns.description: The level of scheduling urgency for the job, e.g. NORMAL, TIME_SENSITIVE, TIME_INSENSITIVE

columns.name: DELAY_TOLERANCE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The amount of execution delay in seconds that the job can tolerate

columns.name: SCHEDULED_TIME
columns.description: The time at which the job is scheduled to run

columns.name: CLIENT_REQUEST_UUID
columns.description: Optional client-given unique identifier for the submitted request.

columns.name: JOB_PAYLOAD
columns.description: This column stores the attributes for Spectra Job submission that are part of the payload for Job request submission

columns.name: JOB_PROGRESS
columns.description: This column store the near real-time progress information for the job request

columns.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Termination timeout threshold in seconds, which is used to automatically timeout and terminate a running job

columns.name: TIMEOUT_DATE
columns.description: The timer set for the current state would expire after the given time

columns.name: JOB_RETRY_POLICY
columns.description: The retry policy could include properties such as retryCount, retryInterval and backoffStrategy etc

columns.name: REMAINING_RETRIES
columns.description: Number of retries yet to be performed. When it reaches 0, we are done with all retries

columns.name: INPUT_FILES_READY
columns.description: Used to indicate that the input files for the job request are ready and the job execution can continue. Possible values are NULL, N, and Y

columns.name: VISIBILITY_DATE
columns.description: The visibility flag used to support multiple consumers

columns.name: PARENT_JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: FK to the original job request

columns.name: NEXT_SCHEDULED_TIME
columns.description: Scheduled time for running the next recurrence of a recurring job

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: Stores the scheduling rules, which is a copy of the runAtTimes property from the request payload

columns.name: LAST_RUN_SCHEDULED
columns.description: Indicates whether the last run per the recurring schedule has already been scheduled and there is no need to calculate NEXT_SCHEDULED_TIME any more

columns.name: NEXT_SCHEDULED_TIMES
columns.description: Stores or caches a number of pre-calculated time slots for running the job for better performance

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
